**Nuka-Grape** is a variant of Nuka-Cola and a soft drink in *Fallout 76*.

Nuka-Grape was originally Grape-Pearl Soda, a patent belonging to Joannie Cheng before its acquisition by the Nuka-Cola Corporation. Its grape flavor profile was not changed, and it was released as Nuka-Grape. [1] Some of the ingredients were adjusted to cut production costs. It comes in a purple bottle with grapes on the label and bottle cap.

The drink restores 100 Hit Points when consumed, along with restoring 50 Action Points and reducing Radiation by 400 points.

- Can be purchased from Bubbles, upstairs in the Whitespring Resort.
- One can be found in a broken locker inside TNT dome #7 at the Black Mountain Ordnance Works.
- Can sometimes be found at the Eta Psi House, in the basement, in the Nuka-Cola room.
- One can be found at Grafton Steel Underground, in a safe requiring 2+ hacking skill.

Nuka-Grape appears in *Fallout 76*.
